description: Spreads an amount over several sources of yield. Returns the blocks (one product per category, no duplicate exposure, each checked at its own amount incl. gas, weight capped), an admixture above the risk budget (default 10 %), the median yield and risk per category, the blended yield compared with the single highest yield, the worst single failure as % of the amount, and an explainer on diversification (with failures on record), purchase order and rebalancing. Checks, not advice.

max_risk.description: Highest risk level for the core blocks (default 3)

price_exposure.description: Allow blocks that move with a crypto price, e.g. staking or pools with ETH (default false)
